fix.pr_body:
## What was missing

There was no bot command to explain when new archetypes are created in Penny Dreadful, leaving moderators without a canned response when players asked why their deck isn't an archetype yet.

## What changed

Added a `sorting` entry to the `explanations` dict in `discordbot/commands/explain.py` with concise text explaining that new archetypes are created when a deck sees significant play (including adoption beyond the original creator) and directing interested players to `#archetype-sorting`.

Also added two aliases so all three suggested command forms work:
- `!explain sorting`
- `!explain archetype-sorting`
- `!explain archetypes`

The text was kept deliberately brief per bakert's guidance in the issue comments about Discord wall-of-text reactions.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit discordbot` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (functional test marked skip by repo)

Fixes #7327
